text_block_list.text: During a casual chat stream one day...

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Loves-chan, do you know that person?
The one who mainly streams fighting games and recently went overseas!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know, I know~! He's super popular worldwide right now. Apparently, he's even kicked off a whole new fighting game boom—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. That's so nice, isn't it?
I'm aiming to go overseas myself,
so it really inspires me in all kinds of ways~.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"First up, the BC!!!!"
"Then Hong Kong or Dubai? There are so many possibilities~"
"Can't wait to see Loves-chan dominate overseas!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it really makes your dreams soar, doesn't it~!
Running in races all over the world, delivering love... and filling the whole world with love!
choice_data_list: It'll definitely happen. In the near future, too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes—but to do that,
there are still so many things I lack...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've been thinking about a lot of things...
and I think I'd like to start preparing,
little by little, to expand overseas!

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Wanting to learn about foreign countries
in preparation for going overseas, huh...
Well, starting with food is a classic."

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe researching overseas trends...
and expanding your circle of friends online?"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"If you're keeping overseas expeditions in mind,
I think it'd be reassuring to study up
on small lifestyle differences and manners, too."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Yep, thank you, everyone!
All right, I'll do every single one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
American BBQ means massive chunks of meat on an iron grill, yes!
Prep in the morning, slow-cook it generously...
Fever all day long! That is what BBQ is all about, yes!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I see, so it's an all-day affair...! I'll do my best, please guide me well!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, she's endlessly grilling giant slabs of meat...!"
"Is authentic BBQ really this much of a marathon...?"
"Loves-chan, please don't overdo it~~..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's done! Pulled pork...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! You did great for three whole hours!
Now, let's take our time and eat a whole buuunch until tonight!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to trends in America...
it's definitely pro wrestling!! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A bird of prey swooping onto the mat!
The hunt begins again today!
Eeeeel Condor! Pasaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Pro wrestling!?!?"
"I can feel the 'pressure' of a hardcore fan..."
"Is she actually going to learn... pro wrestling moves...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll put my everything into pro wrestling!
In order to spread my wings to the world...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nice guts, Loves!!
Next up, here comes the
"Scorpion Deathlock"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A multi-course meal... First up are the appetizers, right!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, forks...?
Which one was I supposed to use first again...?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As long as you work your way from the outside in,
you won't make a mistake.
Shall we go over cutlery etiquette as well?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Next is the main dish...! I think I'm
finally getting the hang of table manners...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think you're really getting the hang of it.
Let's get used to it gradually while enjoying the taste.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"BBQ clear, pro wrestling clear,
table manners clear!
...Maybe I need to look into hotel situations too?"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan really works hard, doesn't she?"
"And she pulls it off brilliantly too."
"No, seriously, she's amazing..."
She boldly takes on any challenge, works tirelessly, and always sees it through. I can only marvel at her sheer willpower and brilliance. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text: "Loves-chan trying so hard is so precious it brings tears to my eyes... Uuuugh, I'm rooting for her with all my heart, but cheering is all I can do~~~~!"
choice_data_list: It's frustrating that I haven't been able to help much...
It's frustrating that I haven't been able to help much...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that's not true at all!
Everything is thanks to everyone's support.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The cooking, the pro wrestling, the studying of foreign customs that I've worked so hard on... They are all paths everyone showed me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because the desire to repay everyone's support and love sprouted within me,
a big dream was born—to go overseas."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, okay? Please don't say "all you could do was cheer."
More than anything, it's thanks to your precious support
that I'm standing here today.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan..." "Thank you, Loves!"
"Woaaaah!! Take this super-sized cheer from all of us~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that!
I'm gonna keep taking on challenge after challenge, so keep your eyes on me!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Next up is the 'Let's Make Friends Overseas' project!
Since Japanese anime, manga, and 2D content are so popular abroad..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm going to make lots of new friends through drawing!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――I know. I know full well...
That my art is, well, rather "avant-garde"...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, my goal is the world stage!
If I want to spread my wings across the globe, no matter how tough it gets,
I have to challenge myself, work hard, and overcome it!!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"What is this...??"
"A sea cucumber, maybe...?"
"Depending on how you look at it... it might be cute."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's a hamster, a hamster!
Look, here are the eyes, and here are the whiskers!
choice_data_list: ...Want to do some special drawing practice?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...You're right... Yes, I know.
You can't get better overnight...!
I'll do my best with my drawing practice...!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
""We've hit the toughest wall at the very end..."
"Hang in there, Loves, do your absolute best!"
"Go ask your childhood friend for help!""

Looking ahead to her future overseas challenge,
Loves Only You pushes on!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You think so?!
Trainer, wasn't that totally monotone?!
choice_data_list: No, but it definitely has a lot of character.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You think so?!
Trainer, wasn't that totally monotone?!
choice_data_list: No, but it definitely has a lot of character.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Fr fr" "This is nice in its own way"
"Actually makes her more relatable"
"The 'master artist' gimmick will probably be a hit overseas too. Maybe."

Turn weak points into charm points instead.
With an eye toward expanding overseas someday,
she vowed to work hard and get creative!
